# Platform coverage gate detection, 2026-10-04

The coherent38 source model run had six failures. Five belong to the separately owned initializer fixture packet. The remaining platform coverage failure comes from a raw text regular expression: it treats the literal source quoted in an APPLY admission assertion as an executable network gate in platform-coverage.test.ts itself. Root's complete platform PostgreSQL run already passed 2633 cases, no failures and eight declared skips, satisfying all907 strict requirements. Those runtime results remain bound to the original coherent38 tree and do not execute this correction.

This two-path packet replaces only that discovery predicate with a TypeScript AST walk using the already locked compiler dependency. The walk recognizes the exact process.env.ZENITH_TEST_TOFU_NETWORK access in either side of strict or loose equality comparisons. Static bracket access, optional chains, parentheses, type assertions and actual template interpolations remain executable comparisons. String literals, plain template text, regular expressions, comments and type labels do not execute their quoted expressions and therefore supply no comparison node.

The original complete quoted assertion remains unchanged. There is no own-file exemption, identifier split, hidden literal, path allowlist or report waiver. Every discovered runtime-gated file still must belong to the existing exact real-engine requirement set. All original suite titles, manifest907 identities, historical799 SHA, PostgreSQL80, package22, missing/failed/skipped/PGlite/zero/duplicate and execution-binding controls remain byte-exact. The production manifest and checker are read-only dependencies.

Eighteen additive source-model identities challenge six false-positive forms, ten real runtime comparison forms, a mixed quoted/actual expression and foreign-object/flag/type text. The walk is syntactic direct-access coverage, preserving and widening the original scanner's comparison scope. It does not claim complete semantic data flow through arbitrary aliases, dynamically computed property names or shadowed process bindings. Mandatory compilation and complete real-engine reports remain independent controls.

The prepared baseline is the exact coherent38 Git tree df9aedc92fe9bdd173a571e543391a02bdba754f, copied through a private index into an isolated worktree off09301572. Root's real staged index and all frozen prior packets remain unchanged. Every project import, compiler, lint, test, service, install and commit by the author is unrun. Git/Python source integrity checks alone establish the frozen patch and inventories.

Root must run pinned Node22 compilation and the focused platform coverage/source-model suite, then the coherent source/model successor with C's independent initializer fixture correction. Source review does not establish those executions. No PostgreSQL requirement changes, public API, default server, browser transport or provider call is introduced.
